newsitem.title: USA: Superoctanos MTBE unit downed by power failure.
newsitem.headline: Superoctanos MTBE unit downed by power failure.

text.p: Superoctanos' MTBE complex in Jose, Venezuela, shutdown early Friday morning due to an electrical failure, a company official said.
The official said the 12,500 MTBE plant, which has been in on extended turnaround, will return online to full capacity by late afternoon.
The official said it was unclear if the power failure was contained to the complex or affected other parts of the country.

The MTBE unit was originally scheduled to return to full production on June 30 but has been delayed by technical problems. The latest startup date was this morning. -- New York Oil Desk 1212-859-1631 --
